INBOUND.predicate: doc_type=receipt, deleted_at IS NULL, dst_warehouse_id=current confirmed warehouse

OUTBOUND.predicate: doc_type=issue, deleted_at IS NULL, src_warehouse_id=current confirmed warehouse

WARRANTY.predicate: persisted warranty owner matches current confirmed warehouse

identity.deduplication: Deduplicate only by source plus canonical owner UUID. Never deduplicate by document_no. Equal UUIDs from different sources remain distinct records.

row_contract.canonical_status: Unmodified status from the canonical owner
row_contract.mini_app_status: Source-owned projection defined by status_mapping; never a common inferred approval state

readiness.applicable: false for warranty; true for stock documents
readiness.ready_for_post: INBOUND only; null for other sources
readiness.ready_for_issue: OUTBOUND only; null for other sources
readiness.can_post: INBOUND only; requires full scan and complete SKU name/unit
readiness.blockers: Explicit source-owned blockers; never inferred from a display label
readiness.source: Canonical columns used for the projection

status_mapping.p13_rule: P13 historical RECORD receipt is handoff evidence only. It never overwrites current canonical_status, mini_app_status or readiness.
status_mapping.waiting_approval_rule: WAITING_APPROVAL applies only to INBOUND SCANNING with every planned line fully scanned. It is never a cross-source default.

query.status: ALL or source-qualified canonical status, for example INBOUND:SCANNING
query.date_semantics: created_at normalized to UTC before UNION/filter/sort; local date bounds use Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh and an exclusive next-midnight upper bound

counts.meta.total: Count of the complete authorized and filtered selected source scope before cursor pagination
counts.meta.source_facets: Counts of every authorized source under the same keyword/status/date/upper-bound filters before source selection and cursor pagination

rules: Any unavailable or malformed authorized source fails the complete aggregate response.
A failed source is never converted to an empty array or zero total.
A denied source is excluded by authorization and reported as DENIED with total null; this is not a source failure.

snapshot.response: One database read snapshot per response
snapshot.cursor_upper_bound: The first request fixes an upper_bound_created_at; newer records are excluded from later cursor pages
snapshot.late_backdated_changes: May change later page totals/results; client must restart after cursor errors or explicit refresh
